gloss: art of conversation; speaking skill; eloquence

definitions.gloss: art of conversation; speaking skill; eloquence; gift of gab
definitions.explanation: The skill or technique of engaging people through speech, encompassing storytelling, persuasion, and the ability to hold an audience's attention in conversation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{話術|わじゅつ}に{長|た}けている。
examples.english: He is skilled in the art of conversation.

examples.japanese: {巧|たく}みな{話術|わじゅつ}で{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}を{引|ひ}きつけた。
examples.english: He captivated the audience with skillful speaking.

examples.japanese: あの{営業|えいぎょう}{担当|たんとう}は{話術|わじゅつ}が{上手|じょうず}で、どんな{相手|あいて}でもすぐに{打|う}ち{解|と}けてしまう。
examples.english: That salesperson is so good at conversation that they can quickly break the ice with anyone.

notes:
Refers to the technique or skill of engaging people through speech — not just public speaking but the broader ability to hold and direct conversation effectively. Combines {話|わ} (talk, story) and {術|じゅつ} (technique, art).

USAGE:
- Covers a range of speaking abilities: storytelling, persuasion, entertainment, negotiation
- Often used to praise someone who can hold an audience's attention or smoothly navigate conversations
- Can also refer to the traditional Japanese art of {話芸|わげい} (spoken performance arts like rakugo)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話術|わじゅつ}に{長|た}ける: to be skilled in conversation
- {話術|わじゅつ}が{上手|じょうず}: good at speaking
- {巧|たく}みな{話術|わじゅつ}: skillful eloquence
- {話術|わじゅつ}を{磨|みが}く: to polish one's speaking skills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弁舌|べんぜつ}: eloquence, oratory — more formal, focuses on persuasive speaking
- {話芸|わげい}: spoken performance art — specifically traditional Japanese storytelling arts
- トーク{力|りょく}: talking ability — the loanword-based casual equivalent
- {雄弁|ゆうべん}: eloquence — more about powerful, persuasive rhetoric
